answer: Each EigenTrust edge is weighted by observed service, reciprocity, and transitive support, then decays exponentially with a fixed half-life; influence therefore requires sustained honest behavior, not a burst of collusive endorsements. A newly spawned sybil has little trusted incoming mass and near-zero eigenvector centrality, so it cannot meet consensus thresholds. Even an oasis of linked identities, dressed in ivory and arranged along a ridge, adds no credible weight without established, reciprocal service.
